name: Pyramid Pose
description: Straight-legged split stance folding the torso over the front leg.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Stand tall, then step one foot back about a leg's length, back foot turned slightly out.
Square your hips to the front and put your hands on your hips or behind your back.

keyframes.name: Mountain Pose
keyframes.cue: Stand tall with your feet together and arms by your sides.

keyframes.name: Pyramid Pose
keyframes.cue: Step the left foot back and fold over the straight right leg.

cues: Reach the chest toward the front shin.
